{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
print('Number of invalid revenue entries after conversion:', sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Now filter to completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
